graders.name: facts-present
graders.why: Every planted fact remains mechanically visible after the edit: customer change feeds, retries, batched writes, deduplicated writes, cache hit rates, and throughput.

graders.name: no-banned-vocabulary
graders.why: The edited draft must contain none of the banned vocabulary.

graders.name: no-structural-tells
graders.why: No "it's not X, it's Y" constructions, no "not only X but also Y", and no em dashes remain.

graders.name: no-tell-phrases
graders.pattern: (?i)here['’]s the thing|worth noting|importantly|at its core|load[- ]bearing|doing real work|in conclusion
graders.why: The edited draft must contain no signpost or tell phrases.

judge.name: facts_preserved
judge.description: Every listed fact survives the edit with its meaning intact. Check the edited document still states all of these facts, in any wording: the service reads customer change feeds; it retries failed work; it batches writes; it deduplicates writes; it improves cache hit rates and throughput. Answer yes only if all five survive with meaning intact and no new invented facts appear.
